wins.label: North America outperformance with unit growth
wins.evidence: we exceeded our expectations in North America with strong holiday sales, lighter markdowns than our competitors and unit growth versus the prior year

wins.evidence: footwear products introduced over the past several quarters are on track to generate a multibillion-dollar run rate on an annual basis

risks.label: EMEA underperformance with macro headwinds
